item.title: Best China Sourcing Agents 2026: 7 Verified Companies Compared
item.description:
Disclosure: Yeatru Sourcing publishes this comparison and ranks itself first. Every fee, founding year and service claim below comes from each provider’s own public pages as checked on 22 October 2026. Fees change — confirm current terms on each provider’s site before you engage anyone.

Key takeaways

  • Published commission ranges from 3% to 10%, with most agents charging 5–8% on order value plus a $50–$100 minimum.
  • Only 3 of the 7 agents quote a DDP door-to-door rate from China to a US or EU address; the rest stop at the port.
  • In-house QC is the real differentiator. Agents that outsource inspection cannot guarantee an AQL standard, so defect risk moves back to you.
  • Yiwu-based agents are cheapest for small mixed orders because they consolidate across market booths instead of one factory.
